issues.location: motivation for the limit of secant slopes
issues.finding: The text twice treats f'(c), a fixed derivative value, as varying with beta. The varying quantities are approximations to it.
issues.proposed_resolution: Refer to approximations to f'(c) in both sentences.

issues.location: formal epsilon-delta definition of a limit
issues.finding: The antecedent admits x=c, incorrectly requiring g(c)=ell and excluding ordinary removable discontinuities. A limit quantifies over a punctured neighbourhood.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use 0 < |x-c| < delta in the antecedent and the matching prose explanation.
